subject: Context-length choices and token forecast — Helio Health onboarding
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@heliohealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: model/context questions before implementation

Hi Rishi / Monica —

Quick context: we’re getting ready to move the clinical-notes summarization MVP from prototype to integration. Before our technical kickoff we wanted to confirm a few important sizing decisions so the implementation plan can lock in model choices and capacity. Can you help with the following?

1) Recommended model shortlist for high-accuracy clinical summarization (PHI present). We need options across cost/latency tradeoffs.
2) Suggested max context length(s) to support — e.g., 8k vs 32k — and implications to latency/cost.
3) Token volume projection: we expect ~1,100 active users during pilot, roughly 2.5 calls/user/day, avg doc size uncertain (we’ll attach sample docs), but we want a Monte Carlo-ish monthly token estimate to budget.

Attached: sample_docs.zip (see helio_token_profile.csv that breaks down doc lengths).

Also confirm any compliance-side constraints for Hosted vs Dedicated — we will require SOC2-level logs and are willing to discuss Dedicated if needed for PHI.

Thanks — can we get a short write-up by EOD Friday?

Dana Liu
Director, Implementation
Helio Health

---
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@heliohealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model/context questions before implementation

Dana — thanks for the clear list. Below is a compact summary to help your team decide prior to the tech kickoff. I attached a quick spreadsheet that converts your sample_doc token histogram into monthly estimates.

Model shortlist (initial, ordered by cost -> accuracy):
- distilled-mistral-instruct-7b (low-cost, good latency; 8k context recommended)
- llama2-13b-q4f (balanced cost/quality; 8k or 16k depending on doc sizes)
- redwood-extended-32k (higher cost, best for long threaded notes; recommend only for documents that require full 32k window)

Context-length guidance:
- Conservative rollout: start with 8k (covers ~88% of your sample docs per helio_token_profile.csv).
- Evaluate 16k as a middle ground for long consult notes; keep 32k reserved for specific workloads where truncation causes accuracy loss.
- Impact: moving from 8k -> 32k increases per-token latency slightly and raises infra memory needs (~2x peak KV cache per request for attention state). Cost increases depend on batching; we include model-specific cost rows in the attached spreadsheet.

Token-volume estimate (we ran your sample through our estimator):
- Median doc: ~1,450 tokens; 90th percentile: ~4,800 tokens.
- Pilot assumptions: 1,100 DAU * 2.5 calls/day * avg 1,450 tokens => ~3,987,500 tokens/day => ~120M tokens/month (input+output combined conservative estimate).
- If 10% of calls require 16k/32k windows, expect a 20–35% incremental cost uplift depending on model and batching.

Compliance note:
- If PHI retention or audit logs are required beyond default Hosted plan, Dedicated is recommended. Hosted can be configured with SOC2 log exports; Dedicated gives you tenant isolation and customer-managed KMS for long-term retention. We should confirm minimal retention windows and whether you need on-prem options.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm initial context target (8k vs 16k) and whether to enable a small subset of 32k traffic for validation.
2) Monica will draft implementation milestones and a canary rollout plan.
3) Schedule the technical kickoff (30–45m) for next week so SRE/Dev can validate capacity.

Attachments: model_shortlist_budget_estimates.xlsx, helio_token_profile.csv

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Rishi@redwood.inference

---
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@heliohealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model/context/questions before implementation

Thanks Rishi — very helpful. A couple quick clarifications:

- We can start with 8k as the baseline. Clinical intake notes are the highest volume; some consult threads can hit ~18k tokens. We want to sample those at 32k to validate quality loss from truncation.
- PHI: we will need SOC2 evidence and audit logs; for pilot we can use Hosted with strict log export, but Dedicated is on the table if logs/retention become a blocker.
- The token spreadsheet looks reasonable; I shared a cleaned sample set (implementation@heliohealth.com) with a few long threads flagged.

Can you & Monica include a short section in the kickoff agenda that outlines immediate tradeoffs and cost delta if 10% of traffic needs 32k?

Dana

---
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@heliohealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model/context questions before implementation

Dana — looping in a concise implementation plan and owners. High-level timeline and asks below; I attached a kickoff agenda draft (implementation_kickoff_agenda.docx).

Implementation plan (pilot):
- Week 0: confirm context target (you chose 8k baseline + 10% 32k sampling).
- Week 1: provide sample prompts + dev hooks (Helio to provide sanitized prompts and API schema).
- Week 2: integration + internal QA (Redwood: provide canary routing, batching config, caching profile).
- Week 3: pilot live (monitoring + cost/day cadence).

Technical asks for kickoff:
- Helio: sanitized sample prompts, exact SLA/retention requirements for logs, and a point-of-contact for SSO/KMS discussion.
- Redwood: we will present the model shortlist tradeoffs, token-cost sensitivity table, and a recommended batching/cache profile for 8k workloads.

Operational notes:
- KV prefix caching: we recommend enabling prefix caching for repeated patient queries to cut token costs ~10–15% for repeat flows.
- Batching: for interactive UIs target 30–50ms per-token internal processing; we will propose batch sizes that hit those SLOs in the kickoff.

Proposed kickoff times (PT): Tue 18 Feb 14:00, Wed 19 Feb 10:00 — which works for you?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.inference

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@heliohealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model/context questions before implementation

Hi Dana — a few concrete engineering recommendations to include in the kickoff deck so your infra team knows what to expect: 

1) Quantization / model variant: start pilot on llama2-13b-q4f for balance. If you need lower cost, move to distilled-mistral-instruct-7b with int4 quant. For long-window validation use redwood-extended-32k with q4f and GPU memory pinned to 40GB instances.

2) Cost examples (approx, input+output):
- distilled-mistral-instruct-7b (8k): ~$1.8 / 1M tokens
- llama2-13b-q4f (8k): ~$3.6 / 1M tokens
- redwood-extended-32k (32k): ~$9.5 / 1M tokens (higher due to memory and slower batching)

3) Monitoring & rollouts:
- Canary 5% traffic for 32k variant, track rouge/ROUGE-L / hallucination regression on a fixed prompt set.
- Enable token-level billing traces in Redwood Console for daily cost attribution per route.

4) Implementation knobs we’ll expose at kickoff: batching window (ms), max_batch_size, kv_prefix_ttl, and quantization profile toggle.

I can present a short cost/latency tradeoff slide and a recommended default config during the kickoff. If the dates Monica proposed work, I prefer Wed 19 Feb 10:00 PT.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.inference
